name: poiesis-design
description: Design toolkit for Claude Code: how a UI looks (typography, hierarchy, spacing and color as shared tokens, with an auditor and a publish gate) and how it behaves (UX rules and a tester that walks the app's tasks).

plugins.name: poiesis-design
plugins.description: UI and UX for any project. ui: typography, hierarchy, spacing and color in atoms → cells, rules, ui-auditor and a publish gate. ux: behavior rules with sources (Nielsen, WCAG 2.2, ISO 9241-110) and ux-tester, which walks the project's tasks in the running app.
